widget.doc: The session screen's one focal point: a big countdown ring that drains with left (seconds) on a surface that changes with phase ("ready" shows the jumper, "set" the count-in, "work" the bright surface, "rest" the calm one), with the round marks (round of rounds), the time to go, and paused=true dimming it; pass work and rest (the phase lengths in seconds).

props.doc: The line under the round marks (empty: written from the phase, e.g. "Next: rest for 20 s").
Seconds left in this phase: the big number and the arc.
ready (before the start: the jumper, no clock), set (the short count-in from 3), work or rest.
The round in progress, from 1 (0 before the first).
The planned rounds: one mark each.
Dims the dial and says Paused.
The word over the number while working.
The word over the number while resting.
The word over the number during the count-in.
The chip over the jumper before the start.
Who the drawing is for: adult (lean, calm) or kid (rounder, playful, with confetti).

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= (props.paused ? theme.colors.panelBar : props.phase == 'rest' ? theme.colors.restTrack : props.phase == 'ready' ? theme.colors.heroChip : theme.colors.workTrack)}

props.text: ${= upper(props.phase == 'ready' ? props.readyLabel : props.phase == 'set' ? text(props.rounds) + ' rounds' : 'Round ' + text(props.round) + ' of ' + text(props.rounds))}
